boundedClaim: Heartbeat scene source preserves last-good semantic contact while clamping node-level transition motion on rejected refreshes, treats pulseId as an idempotent contact identity, and exposes the repaired contract through regression source plus a touchable non-raster specimen, without phone/P0 mutation.

findings.finding: Interrupted frames could carry stale node.transitionMotion=true even though frame.transitionMotionAllowed=false because preserveLastGood reused prior node objects.
findings.repair: Preserved semantic nodes are re-materialized with transitionMotion=false; checkpoint equality, not object identity, is the preserved invariant.

findings.finding: The same visible pulseId could previously be reused with changed contact semantics, weakening idempotent retry identity.
findings.repair: Exact same-id retry is accepted only when visible contact SHA is unchanged; a same-id semantic collision fails closed with an explicit boundary and preserved last-good contact.

findings.finding: The first art draft wired animation to a selector no rendered node had.
findings.repair: Animation now targets the real light heading nodes.

findings.finding: The art draft exposed both the whole changing stage and a dedicated status node as polite live regions, risking duplicate TalkBack announcements.
findings.repair: The stage is no longer a live region; the dedicated atomic status node is the sole change announcement surface.
